exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-28T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix list-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential

exec card create --priority 0 'Ready task'
exec card create --priority 1 'Prerequisite task'
exec card create --priority 2 --depends-on list-2 'Blocked task'
exec card create --priority 1 'In progress task'
exec card --actor worker claim list-4
exec card create --priority 1 'Waiting task'
exec card --actor worker claim list-5
exec card --actor worker release list-5 --waiting 'root acceptance'
exec card create --priority 1 'Closed task'
exec card close list-6
exec card create --priority 1 'Cancelled task'
exec card cancel list-7

# Unqualified listing includes every non-terminal presentation status.
exec card list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/default.txt

# An explicit terminal status replaces the default selection.
exec card list --status closed
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/closed.txt

# Title matching uses Go regular-expression syntax.
exec card list --title-regexp '^(Ready|Waiting) task$'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/title-regexp.txt

! exec card list --title-regexp '['
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/title-regexp-error.txt

# Retired filters are rejected at the command boundary.
! exec card list --title Ready
stderr 'unknown flag --title'
! exec card list --no-labels
stderr 'unknown flag --no-labels'
! exec card list --priority-min 1
stderr 'unknown flag --priority-min'
! exec card list --priority-max 3
stderr 'unknown flag --priority-max'
! exec card list --summary contract
stderr 'unknown flag --summary'

-- golden/default.txt --
ID      PRI  STATUS       TYPE  TITLE
list-1  0    ready        task  Ready task
list-2  1    ready        task  Prerequisite task
list-3  2    blocked      task  Blocked task
list-4  1    in_progress  task  In progress task
list-5  1    waiting      task  Waiting task
-- golden/closed.txt --
ID      PRI  STATUS  TYPE  TITLE
list-6  1    closed  task  Closed task
-- golden/title-regexp.txt --
ID      PRI  STATUS   TYPE  TITLE
list-1  0    ready    task  Ready task
list-5  1    waiting  task  Waiting task
-- golden/title-regexp-error.txt --
error: invalid --title-regexp "[": error parsing regexp: missing closing ]: `[`
